prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: one high-resolution transparent PNG character asset for the existing SalaryMate website.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact identity and pose reference/edit target: Jingyu, a cream-white and warm gold owl, standing front-facing with a gentle head tilt, one wing raised in a friendly wave at image-left, the other lowered beside the book. Image 2 is ONLY a rendering-quality reference for smooth detailed feathers, fabric, eyes, and gemstones. Do not copy Image 2's flight poses, multiple-character sheet, or background.
Primary request: redraw and refine the single owl from Image 1 with higher-quality smooth animated-illustration rendering. Preserve the same recognizable owl identity, facial proportions, big turquoise eyes, happy open golden beak, expressive pointed ear tufts, standing pose and slight head tilt, single raised waving wing, golden feet, navy-blue cape with gold edging, turquoise diamond clasp, and matching navy-and-gold book with turquoise diamond on the same side. Keep the same outfit shapes and color palette.
Materials/textures: delicately layered cream and ivory feathers with fine individual feather definition, soft warm-gold shadows; rich navy fabric with readable folds; precise gold trim and book hardware; clear luminous turquoise eye irises and faceted turquoise jewels. Clean natural contours and softly polished animation-art shading, not blocky or pixel art. The detail should remain readable when displayed large in a website header.
Composition/framing: exactly ONE complete character, alone, centered on a square 1536 x 1536 canvas. The full character should occupy approximately 82% of the canvas height with at least 8% transparent padding on every side. Include all ear tips, wing tips, cape, feet, and the entire book without cropping. Maintain Image 1's standing-in-place posture; the feet are extended down in the original standing arrangement, not tucked up for flight.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha, no painted backdrop.
Constraints: change only rendering clarity and fine detail. No pose redesign, no flying, no extra character or props, no multiple panels or variants, no ground plane, no pedestal, no ground/contact shadow, no halo or glow behind the character, no decorative particles, no text, no logo, no watermark. Transparent pixels outside the character.
visual_inspection: Single complete standing owl with original slight head tilt, raised image-left waving wing, cape, jewel, and book. Feather, gold trim, and eye rendering is smooth and sharper. No background, text, duplicate character, base, or ground shadow visible.
limitations: The generated image is 1254 x 1254 rather than the requested 1536-square. Visible subject bbox at alpha >128 is [67,8,1202,1246], so the requested 8% transparent padding was not met. Low-alpha pixels extend to the canvas top/left/bottom. Original generated bitmap preserved unchanged; no second generation requested.
